source.title: Toward Deterministic Wi-Fi: Requirements & Evolution
source.authors: Kazi Huq, Alfred Lin (Sony Corporation), et al.

sourceCheck.method: Downloaded from the direct PPTX link in the IEEE WNG July 2026 index; inspected all slide XML text and rendered original slides 8 and 11 using PowerPoint for visual comparison
sourceCheck.slide8: The authors' table associates EDCA with possible contention latency variation, TWT with no guarantee of deterministic access from scheduled wake-up, RTWT with variable timing boundaries, trigger-based access with availability of scheduled opportunities, and multi-AP coordination with possible timing overhead.
sourceCheck.slide11: The authors explicitly propose a two-step evolution: transitional slot-based operation retaining CSMA/CA for legacy and best-effort traffic, then green-field fully scheduled operation without CSMA/CA dependency.
sourceCheck.statusBoundary: These are authors' July 2026 discussion and proposal, not an adopted IEEE standard or measured performance result.
